items.summaryEn: F1 Champion – Grande Kimi 🇮🇹 Big respect for becoming the world’s youngest world champion ever in our sport! You worked so damn hard since karting times, where everyone was sure you are a generational talent – but proving this now in F1 and mastering all that pressure is just phenomenal. Well deserved, enjoy every moment!!
detailZh: F1 冠军 – Grande Kimi 🇮🇹 对于成为我们这项运动中世界最年轻的世界冠军，我表示极大的敬意！自从卡丁车时代起，每个人都确信你是一位跨时代的天才——但现在在F1中证明这一点并掌握所有压力，真是太了不起了。当之无愧，享受每一个时刻！！
detailEn: F1 Champion – Grande Kimi 🇮🇹 Big respect for becoming the world’s youngest world champion ever in our sport! You worked so damn hard since karting times, where everyone was sure you are a generational talent – but proving this now in F1 and mastering all that pressure is just phenomenal. Well deserved, enjoy every moment!!
